entities.summary: Chinese Qing, a notable figure in the history of Vietnam, associated with Trinh-Nguyen Division (1771–1802). Preceded by Tay Son Rebellion and Reunification and Alexandre de Rhodes develops the Romanized Vietnamese script (quoc ngu). Their legacy influenced Emperor Gia Long unifies Vietnam and establishes the imperial capital at Hue.
